name: Farewell Strathclyde University 2026

venue.name: Learning and Teaching Building, Strathclyde University

information:
### After 32 competitions at Strathclyde, this weekend we celebrate the swan song of a much-loved venue. Please join us for 4 days of competing as we bid it a fond farewell!

#### This competition runs Saturday - Tuesday, however competitors are welcome to attend as many days of the event as they wish and more popular events will take place on the Saturday and Sunday.

##### Please note that there is a competitor limit in place at this competition for 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and 3x3 Multi-Blind of 20 competitors per event.

Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**
